name: Info Edge (India) Limited
summary: Info Edge (India) Limited operates as an online classifieds company in the areas of recruitment, matrimony, real estate, and education and related services in India and internationally. It operates through Recruitment Solutions, 99acres for Real Estate, and Other segments.
